source_identity.canonical_title: Les trumpistes ne sont pas moins violents envers les femmes conservatrices qu'envers les féministes

translation.canonical_title: Trump supporters are no less violent toward conservative women than toward feminists
translation.displayed_title: Trump supporters are no less violent toward conservative women than toward feminists
translation.summary: The treatment of conservative women by men on their own side shatters the narrative that feminism is the cause of Trumpism. Indeed, these men are every bit as violent toward them as toward feminists, which would not be the case if their grievances were directed only at the latter. Conservative women therefore learned the hard way that making concessions to a potentially antagonistic social group does not lead to better treatment by that group—quite the contrary.
